tone.target: bright clean pop-rock with chorus shimmer and light edge
tone.profile: bright clean pop-rock with chorus shimmer and light edge
tone.summary: Clean signal chain utilizing a Boost/OD for slight edge, followed by Chorus for shimmer, into the US Deluxe amp model paired with a bright 2x12 cabinet. Light delay adds space.
corrections: drop fuzz; use light edge only

rig.name: Mongol800 - DONT WORRY BE HAPPY - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide slight breakup and gentle grit for the 'light edge' requirement.
blocks.gap: The Boost pedal is used to simulate a clean boost/overdrive effect without heavy saturation, fulfilling the 'slight breakup' need.

blocks.purpose: Create the required 'chorus shimmer' and central element of the tone.
Bypass or use a very subtle drive if needed; kept off to avoid heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: The 'light edge' is handled by the Boost pedal (Order 2), so no dedicated DST unit is required and should be bypassed.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright, clean foundation suitable for pop-rock and single-coil tones.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the best choice for a bright, non-vintage saturated tone.

blocks.purpose: Match the bright, clean character of the US Deluxe amp.
Brighten the overall tone and enhance clarity for arpeggios.
blocks.gap: Used to fine-tune the bright, pop-rock character after the amp/cab stage.

blocks.purpose: Add the required 'light delay' and shimmer/space to the arpeggios.
Add subtle ambience and shimmer without sounding overly wet or vintage.
blocks.gap: Room reverb provides a natural, bright space that complements the pop-rock genre.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and tonal clarity for pop-rock arpeggios.

proposals.reason: Enhance the bright, clean character needed for pop-rock arpeggios.
